purpose: Determine whether one coherent target-independent category or filter correction remains after P5, without invoking the official evaluator or altering P5 behavior.
residual_population: Every P5 miss and every P5 hit below rank one in the stored 64-session non-public shadow protocol; official outcomes may be summarized only after the diagnosis is frozen and are not runtime inputs.

required_conditions: The target was present in the protected lexical or bounded fused candidate stage.
Disclosed runtime evidence was compatible with the target.
The target was subsequently removed or materially penalized by category, metadata, price, or hard-constraint handling.
The removal or penalty was caused by missing, uncertain, incorrectly normalized, or overly strict catalog or state evidence.
The failure is repairable through one general target-independent policy.
not_category_c: The target was absent from all bounded retrieval stages.
The target genuinely contradicted explicit high-confidence current requirements.
The target only lost to stronger compatible evidence without a filter or unsupported contradiction.
Recovery would require a target identifier, session identifier, future turn, hidden label, full-catalog response-time scan, or invented candidate.

per_session_observations: target presence and rank in raw current-message lexical, contextual fused, category-evidence candidate, contradiction-filtered, reranked, and final pools
the exact filter, contradiction, category normalization, metadata, price, or hard-constraint decision responsible
catalog metadata status as explicit, missing, ambiguous, malformed, or contradictory
category confidence as explicit high-confidence or uncertain
scenario, turn, final rank, oracle contribution, and conservative realizable contribution

diagnostic_only_oracle.method: Move a qualifying target to its best defensible bounded-stage rank without changing any other session.

conservative_realizable_ceiling.method: For one coherent sub-cause only, reinstate or remove an unsupported penalty while preserving explicit contradictions and the existing bounded candidate set.

selection_rule: Select at most one correction family matching the largest conservative realizable category-C sub-cause. If the continuation gate fails, retain P5 and stop without selecting another mechanism.
